display.purpose: The monumental results WPM figure — signage yellow B612 Mono on board black, one per screen at most.

headline.purpose: The termtype wordmark only; 2.25rem, 3rem at sm:.

title.purpose: Sentence-case bold titles on yellow sign bands (15-16px).

body.purpose: Panel content and hints, 13-15px, lowercase tool-like register.

label.purpose: Uppercase departures-board micro-labels, 11-13px bold tracking-wide; the only uppercase in the system.

terminal.purpose: B612 Mono inside the glass; user-set size 1rem-1.5rem, line-height 1.9, ligatures off.

shadows.name: sign-hang
shadows.purpose: Sign bands — the sheet hangs in the hall.

shadows.name: panel-hang
shadows.purpose: White content panels under sign bands.

shadows.name: terminal-hang
shadows.purpose: The terminal glass; deepest shadow in the system.

shadows.name: night-sign-glow
shadows.purpose: Night only: sign bands read as backlit.

shadows.name: night-board-ring
shadows.purpose: Night only: white edge ring keeps boards legible on the dark hall.

motion.name: flap

components.name: Sign Band (hung)
components.description: The signature container: yellow band hung from two black stems, pictogram square, sentence-case title, drawn arrow.
components.html: Test
components.css: .ds-sign-band { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-top: 14px; padding: 8px 14px; background: var(--w-sign, #ffd200); color: var(--w-board, #17181c); box-shadow: 0 6px 16px -8px rgba(23,24,28,0.4); font-family: 'PT Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-sign-band::before, .ds-sign-band::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -14px; width: 4px; height: 14px; background: var(--w-board, #17181c); } .ds-sign-band::before { left: 12%; } .ds-sign-band::after { right: 12%; } .ds-picto { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; background: var(--w-board, #17181c); color: #ffffff; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-picto svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; } .ds-sign-title { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-sign-arrow { width: 20px; height: 20px; margin-left: auto; flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Start Button
components.description: The departure block: board-black, bold white label, drawn arrow that advances on hover.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-start">Start typing<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3.5 12h16M13.5 6l6 6-6 6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-start { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 14px 24px; background: var(--w-board, #17181c); color: #ffffff; font-family: 'PT Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; border: none; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 6px 16px -8px rgba(23,24,28,0.5); } .ds-btn-start svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; flex-shrink: 0; transition: transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-start:hover { background: #000000; } .ds-btn-start:hover svg { transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-btn-start:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--w-board, #17181c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Segment (destination rail)
components.description: Black rail of choices divided by hairlines; the followed destination stays lit in signage yellow with a drawn chevron.
components.css: .ds-segment { display: inline-flex; flex-wrap: wrap; background: var(--w-board, #17181c); box-shadow: 0 6px 16px -8px rgba(23,24,28,0.5); } .ds-seg-slot { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 6px 14px; background: transparent; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'PT Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; border: none; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg-slot + .ds-seg-slot { border-left: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.25); } .ds-seg-slot:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15); } .ds-seg-slot.ds-active { background: var(--w-sign, #ffd200); color: #17181a; } .ds-seg-slot.ds-active:hover { background: var(--w-sign, #ffd200); } .ds-seg-slot svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; margin-right: 6px; }

components.name: Toggle (route switch)
components.description: A square that fills into a black pictogram with a white check when the route is open; no pill, no thumb.
components.css: .ds-toggle { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 6px 4px; background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; font-family: 'PT Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-toggle-box { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 24px; height: 24px; flex-shrink: 0; border: 2px solid var(--w-board-soft, #4c4e56); background: var(--w-panel, #ffffff); } .ds-toggle-box.ds-on { border: none; background: var(--w-board, #17181c); color: #ffffff; } .ds-toggle-box svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; } .ds-toggle-label { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--w-ink, #17181c); } .ds-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--w-board, #17181c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Readout (gate-number board)
components.description: Live stat: black board, yellow tabular monospace figure, uppercase white micro-label.
components.css: .ds-readout { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 12px; background: var(--w-board, #17181c); box-shadow: 0 6px 16px -8px rgba(23,24,28,0.5); } .ds-readout-value { font-family: 'B612 Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--w-sign, #ffd200); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-readout-label { font-family: 'PT Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: #ffffff; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Kbd Chip
components.description: Miniature board naming a key; every primary action carries one.
components.css: .ds-keyhint { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-family: 'PT Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: var(--w-board-soft, #4c4e56); } .ds-kbd { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 6px; background: var(--w-board, #17181c); color: #ffffff; font-family: 'B612 Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 0; } .ds-keyhint-label { color: var(--w-ink, #17181c); }

components.name: Category Tile
components.description: Destination tile: hairline-bordered panel at rest; the followed route goes full yellow with a drawn arrow.
components.css: .ds-tiles { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-tile { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; text-align: left; background: var(--w-panel, #ffffff); border: 1px solid var(--w-hall-line, #c9c8c2); border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; color: var(--w-board-soft, #4c4e56); font-family: 'PT Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tile:hover { border-color: var(--w-board-soft, #4c4e56); } .ds-tile.ds-active { background: var(--w-sign, #ffd200); border-color: var(--w-sign, #ffd200); color: #17181a; } .ds-tile svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-tile-name { display: block; font-family: 'B612 Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--w-ink, #17181c); } .ds-tile.ds-active .ds-tile-name { color: #17181a; } .ds-tile-blurb { display: block; font-size: 11px; } .ds-tile.ds-active .ds-tile-blurb { font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Round Pips
components.description: Mastery pips: 3-segment black tracks filling in signage yellow as items are mastered.
components.css: .ds-pips { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; } .ds-pip { display: flex; gap: 1px; width: 32px; height: 10px; padding: 1px; background: var(--w-board, #17181c); overflow: hidden; } .ds-pip-seg { flex: 1; height: 100%; background: transparent; transition: background-color 0.3s; } .ds-pip-seg.ds-fill { background: var(--w-sign, #ffd200); }

narrative.overview: termtype's chrome is an airport terminal building: a concourse-gray hall with faint floor expansion joints, saturated signage-yellow bands hung from black rails, and black departure boards with monumental figures. Every configuration surface is a wayfinding decision point — one sign band per decision, a white content panel beneath it, a drawn white pictogram on a black inset square locked to the band's leading edge. The typing test itself is the gate: a yellow overhead band names the destination, and the user-themed terminal is the jet bridge below it. The world deliberately refuses the dark-app-with-neon-accent default; the ground is light gray by day, and night is a lighting change (hall lights off, signage stays backlit), not a different design. Two token layers coexist and never mix. The --w-* concourse layer is fixed: signage yellow, board black, hall gray. The --t-* terminal layer is user-selectable (dracula, nord, gruvbox, CRT green, paper, …) and rules only the terminal interior — the glass behind the gate sign. Themes never touch the chrome; the chrome never leaks into the terminal.
keyCharacteristics: Signage yellow (#ffd200) reserved exclusively for wayfinding
Square corners everywhere; signs, boards, and panels are flat cut sheets
Drawn SVG pictograms and arrows, never font glyphs or icon libraries
Sentence case on sign bands, uppercase micro-labels per departures-board convention, lowercase tool-like copy
Day/night as hall lighting (data-night on <html>), not as re-theming
One authored ornamental motion: the split-flap

rules.name: The Wayfinding-Only Yellow Rule
rules.body: Signage yellow appears only where a sign would: bands, selected routes, gate numerals, pip fills. It is never a data mark — chart lines and bars on black boards are white and white-alpha (#f2f2ef, rgba(255,255,255,.45)); errors are closed-route red.

rules.name: The Two-Layer Rule
rules.body: --w-* is the fixed concourse; --t-* is the themed terminal interior. No component reads across the boundary. A new chrome surface uses --w-* tokens only; anything behind the terminal glass uses --t-* only.

rules.name: The Lit-Sign Rule
rules.body: Text on yellow is always Sign Ink (#17181a) and text on board black is always Board Lettering (#f2f2ef), day or night. Signs are backlit; the hall lighting never changes what is printed on them.

rules.name: The Departures-Board Case Rule
rules.body: Uppercase exists only at micro-label size (≤13px, bold, tracking-wide). Sign bands use sentence case; running copy is lowercase. No uppercase headlines, ever.

rules.name: The Drawn-Mark Rule
rules.body: Every glyph in the chrome is a drawn SVG stroke — the arrow, check, cross, chevron, and pictograms — in the world's 2.2-stroke grammar (small sub-16px marks thicken to 2.6 for legibility), white on black inset squares or currentColor inline. Font characters, emoji, and icon libraries never appear in the chrome.

rules.name: The Hung-Not-Raised Rule
rules.body: Shadows exist only to say "this sheet hangs in the hall." They never respond to hover or state, and nothing floats above anything else.

rules.name: The One-Flap Rule
rules.body: New surfaces may enter with the quiet spring; only a departures-board figure may flap. No other ornamental motion enters the world.

dos: Do build every new chrome surface from the signage vocabulary: .sign-band, .board, .picto, panel-under-sign — one decision per sign.
Do reserve #ffd200 for wayfinding states (bands, selected routes, gate numerals, pip fills) and use white/white-alpha for data marks on boards.
Do use Sign Ink (#17181a) on yellow and #f2f2ef on board black, in both day and night.
Do draw new marks as SVG strokes in the 2.2 grammar (2.6 below 16px) — extend signage.tsx or the home-screen pictogram set.
Do keep numerals in B612 Mono with tabular-nums, and keep the register lowercase and plain.
Do give every primary action a visible Kbd hint; the product is keyboard-first.
Do style night via html[data-night] overrides of --w-* plus the glow shadows — never per-component dark variants.
donts: Don't round a corner. The chrome is 0px radius throughout.
Don't let --t-* theme variables color anything outside the terminal glass, or --w-* anything inside it.
Don't use font glyphs, emoji, or icon libraries for chrome marks; the arrow is a drawn path, never "→".
Don't use uppercase above micro-label size, or hype copy in any register.
Don't add hover elevation, glows (outside the night lighting model), gradients on materials, or a second ornamental animation.
Don't reintroduce the anti-reference: near-black page + single neon accent + rounded cards is the lane this world exists to refuse.
